note: Vietnam: visa exemption by nationality as the Ministry of Foreign Affairs gives it (read from Wikipedia's copy; the Vietnamese government and MFA hosts refuse or fail for this client): 90 days for Chile and Panama; 45 days for the unilateral tourism exemptions (Switzerland, Czechia and Poland from 1 March 2025; Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Hungary, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Romania, Slovakia and Slovenia from 15 August 2025, with the earlier European and Asian group); 30 days for most of ASEAN, Belarus, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and Mongolia, 21 for the Philippines, 14 for Brunei and Indonesia. Every other nationality may get an e-Visa online for up to 90 days (since 15 August 2023). Phu Quoc's own visa-free entry isn't modelled.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Vietnam: ordinary passports, electronic visa
sources.said: According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Vietnam , the maximum allowed period of stay depends on nationality: 90 days Chile Panama 45 days Belgium Bulgaria Croatia Czechia Denmark Finland France Germany Hungary Italy Japan Luxembourg Netherlands Norway Poland Russia Romania Slovakia Slovenia South Korea Spain Sweden Switzerland United Kingdom 30 days Belarus Cambodia Kazakhstan Kyrgyzstan Laos Malaysia Mongolia Myanmar Singapore Thailand 21 days Philippines 14 days Brunei Indonesia ... Starting from 15 August 2023, an e-Visa is issued to citizens of all countries and territories and is issued for single or multiple entry up to 90 days.
